name: Friedrichskoog (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the unofficial arms of Friedrichskoog (a house on white above a white wavy bar on green).
history: Friedrichskoog bears no arms as an official emblem, but large parts of the population identify with the unofficial arms visible throughout the municipality and the hoisted flag based on them; no blazon exists.

features.role: Friedrichskoog unofficial arms — house above wavy bar
